annotations.title: A payment run's status, per payment, or its audit export

description: Tracks each payment in a run from prepared through approval and release to what landed. Reads the run by run_id: each payment's status (prepared, needs_attention with reasons, no_evidence), its assessment and Rate Receipts, approval, release record and what landed. export: true returns the audit export, where any payment without an assessment, approval or release record shows "no evidence". pr_sample needs no key; a real run needs the router key that made it.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

export.description: true: the audit export (JSON) instead of the run.
